site.title: Rare Disease Education Hub
site.description: A verifiable catalogue of rare-disease education, events and resources.
hero.title: Rare-disease education — organized, verifiable and accessible
hero.body: Find official courses, webinars, programmes and recordings. Original titles and sources are preserved, and unreviewed translations are labelled honestly.
catalogue.heading: Education catalogue
catalogue.intro: Results remain available without JavaScript. Filters add convenience and can be shared through the page address.
catalogue.failed: The filters could not load. All records remain available below.
catalogue.noResults: No records match the selected filters.
filters.heading: Search and filters
filters.search: Search by title, provider or topic
sort.title: Title
resource.fallbackNotice: This content is shown in its source language because no reviewed translation is available.
page.methodology.title: Methodology
page.methodology.body: The catalogue separates source facts, translations and computed states. Dates are structured, and every fact must be traceable to an official source.
page.policy.title: Editorial and inclusion policy
page.policy.body: We include resources with clear educational value and a direct relationship to rare diseases, genomics, advocacy, or related clinical and research practice. A person approves factual changes.
page.accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
page.accessibility.body: The target is WCAG 2.2 level AA. Automated checks are complemented by manual review and are not a claim of complete conformance.
page.accessibility.review: Last manual review: 25 August 2026. Test environments: Chromium, keyboard navigation, 320 CSS pixels and 200% zoom.
page.accessibility.limitations: Known limitations and accessibility reports are handled through the correction procedure.
page.data.title: Data and downloads
page.data.body: Public exports are generated from canonical records and are not edited by hand.
page.corrections.title: Corrections and contact
page.corrections.body: Submit a correction through a GitHub issue and identify the record, field, proposed value and direct official source.
page.changes.title: Change log
page.changes.body: Material architecture and catalogue changes are described in CHANGELOG.md and in pull-request evidence.
page.privacy.title: Privacy
page.privacy.body: The static site requires no account and sends no personal data to a project server. A language preference may be stored only in the browser.
footer.about: An independent education catalogue. Always check the official source before applying or registering.
footer.updated: Statuses are calculated against the current date.
404.title: Page not found
404.body: The address may have changed or the resource may not exist.
